mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal consists of fresh orange and blood orange segments, which are low in fat and protein but provide natural carbohydrates with fiber. For someone with diabetes, these fruits have a moderate glycemic impact due to their natural sugars and fiber content. It is best to consume whole fruits like these rather than fruit juices to maintain better blood sugar control.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Fresh segments of orange and blood orange, providing natural sugars, fiber, and vitamin C.
